architecture: v2 (architecture 2, re-root 2026-11-02: a new world, dataset and shell)
slot_note: Re-rooted at stage 1 from the FC25 seed's economics world (architecture 1 spent, lineage below). Architecture 2 keeps nothing of that world: a Kansas intrastate gas transmission operator files its 2027-2031 integrity plan for a 1974 line after the line's first high-resolution in-line inspection, and the decisive step is re-found in how an external corrosion pit grows on a cathodically protected pipe.
niche: an intrastate gas transmission operator's 2027-2031 integrity plan for a 1974 coal-tar-coated line after its first high-resolution magnetic flux leakage inspection: how many external corrosion anomalies the plan must excavate and repair before they reach 80 per cent of wall, and in which plan year each falls due
analyst_test: A strong analyst who aligns the in-line inspection to the line's stationing, keeps the external metal-loss anomalies the integrity plan covers, reads the cathodic protection surveys, the rectifier inspections and the remediation programme correctly and grows each anomaly at its full-life rate (its 2025 depth over the years since the line was commissioned in 1974, the integrity engineer's standard rate when one inspection exists) files a handful of digs for 2027-2031 against the golden's several dozen, because the line was protected until each rectifier zone's potentials fell short of the criterion, so every active pit has grown only over the years since its zone's protection failed and keeps growing at that pace until its zone is restored.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is each external corrosion anomaly's depth at the end of the plan period, the corrosion growth projection pipeline integrity management makes after an in-line inspection, and it turns on the physics of cathodic protection: a pit on a protected pipe grows only while the pipe-to-soil potential at it fails the criterion; with a hospital's nouns there is no wall being lost, no protection record and no repair depth, so the task stops reading.
layer2_pattern: own:corrosion growth dated by the protection record
layer1: the in-line inspection's odometer distances against the operator's engineering stationing, aligned through the above-ground markers both carry
two cathodic protection survey contractors' layouts, the later one recording potentials as positive millivolt magnitudes
test posts added and renumbered in a 2018 survey upgrade
wall thickness changing at road and river crossings, depths reported as per cent of each joint's own nominal wall
inches and mils in the inspection and field reports against millimetres in the contractor's dig sheets
dig verification reports as a scanned PDF
rectifier inspection readings taken every two months by field technicians, some visits late
stakeholder_role: the integrity engineer who files the operator's 2027-2031 integrity management plan with the state pipeline safety office

spine.entity: one feature the May 2025 magnetic flux leakage tool reported on the Northline (a girth weld, a metal-loss anomaly, a valve, a tee, a marker or a casing end)

world.geography: United States, Kansas (a fictional intrastate natural gas transmission operator and its 1974 line)
world.org_type: an intrastate natural gas transmission operator

driver: A size that grows only while a protecting condition fails, read once, is its rate times the time the condition has failed at it, and that time runs from the moment a second record shows the condition first failing, not from the unit's installation; spreading the size over the unit's whole age slows every growing unit severalfold, so the forward count of units that reach a limit inside the window is a small fraction of the count their growth since the failure gives, and the units that once failed and were restored do not grow at all.
driver_concrete: Each external corrosion pit on the Northline grew only while its rectifier zone's instant-off potentials read short of minus 850 millivolts, which the rectifier inspections and the annual test post surveys date zone by zone, so its growth rate is its May 2025 depth over the time since its zone's protection failed, running on until the remediation programme restores the zone and never in the zones restored before the inspection; spreading the depth over the 50.6 years since commissioning, the full-life rate, files a handful of digs for 2027-2031.
stump: Growing each external anomaly at its full-life rate, its May 2025 depth over the years since the Northline was commissioned in 1974, files a handful of 2027-2031 digs against several dozen, because each active pit grew only over the years since its rectifier zone's protection first failed the criterion and keeps that pace until the zone is restored.

differentiation.task162: task162 replays a pressure-reducing valve hour by hour, its effect acting only in the hours the inlet runs above the setting; here nothing is replayed through a device: each pit's past growth rate is dated from the protection record and projected forward, the size over the time since a dated failure
differentiation.task476: task476 dates each leak's unrecorded start within its survey interval from a seasonal profile of start dates in odour reports to size an emitting duration (an ETL conformance of an inventory); here each zone's protection failure is a dated event in its own rectifier and survey record, and the quantity is a growth rate carried forward to a repair depth
differentiation.task132: task132's replacement restarts a wear curve over a forward horizon; here no unit is replaced: a pit's growth starts when protection fails and stops when it is restored
differentiation.task46: task46 reads a burden on cumulative service exposure from a movement log for a cohort crossing a step; here the exposure is the time a protection criterion failed at each pit, dated by a separate record, and the forward quantity is a depth reaching a limit
differentiation.task161: task161 burns a bought-ahead stock at each holder's own share of its use, a stock drawn down; here nothing is drawn down: a pit's depth is its own rate times the time its zone's protection has failed, and the forward step carries that rate to a repair depth
differentiation.task170: task170 v1 moves units at the first noisy scheduled measurement over a fixed level; here the measurement (the in-line inspection depth) is taken as reported and the decisive step dates each pit's growing period from a separate protection record
differentiation.task259: task259 carries reports filed at earlier dates to a reference date by the level's movement inside reporting units; here no report is carried to a date: one inspection's depth is divided by the time since a dated protection failure to give a rate
differentiation.task87: task87 caps a delivered count by an exclusivity between items in one time slot; here nothing is capped or exclusive: the window is the span a protection criterion failed
differentiation.task105: task105 v1 loses a class of commitments agreed a season before an outlet opens; here no agreement lead or opening date matters: each pit grows only while its zone's potentials fail the criterion
differentiation.task229: task229 biases a published daily value by a convex conversion of a cycled input and v3 overstates a gated stream's capture; here no conversion or capture curve is read: a growth rate is dated from the protection record

lineage.architecture: v1 (architecture 1, the FC25 seed's economics world: a bank research desk's call on the advance real GDP estimate)
lineage.fate: spent 2026-11-02 at the re-root: the honest strategy decomposition_attribution BLOCKed (ban.strategy) against task234 v2, the stage 3 relabel to time_semantics reverted as a card written to pass, and the rule 3 audit AT_RISK (the holding period read off a column of Table 7; P(both landed) about 0.10)
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is the change over a period in the volume of a stock that each holder reports at what it paid, and because a holder's stock on any date was bought over a holding period of its own, the reported value mixes the prices of the weeks the goods were bought in; read at the reporting month's price, the textbook removal of price gains, a price step inside the holding period reads as a fall in volume, read at the period's average price it reads the other way, and only revaluing each holder's stock at the average price over its own holding period, at both ends of the period, separates volume from price.
lineage.driver_concrete: Each industry's end-March and end-June book-value stocks (wholesale, retail and manufacturing, from the trade and business stocks bulletin) are revalued at the average of the industry's input price index over the months its stock-to-sales ratio covers before the change in inventory volume is taken, because import prices rose in March and again in June and the stock on hand at each quarter end was partly bought before each rise; deflating at the quarter end's own price index understates the volume at both quarter ends, the June one by more because the larger leg sits inside its holding period, so the quarter reads as a deeper run-down (2.2 against 2.8), and deflating at the quarter's average price reads it the other way (3.3).
lineage.stump: A strong analyst who takes the desk's track for every line the late bulletin does not feed, builds goods exports and imports from the bulletin section by section and deflates each industry's end-March and end-June book-value stocks by that month's price index, the textbook removal of holding gains, files 2.2 per cent against the golden 2.8, because the June leg of the import price rise reads as a fall in the volume of stocks that were bought before it.

notes: Stump strategy 'other' (named): exposure dating, a degradation that accrues only in the periods its protection fails, the start of each unit's growing period dated by a second record. None of the vocabulary's families is this move: maturity_censoring is periods not yet developed, time_semantics is calendars, as-of and effective dating, binding_constraint is a limit. Gate G forecasting: the correctly read 2025 snapshot does not pin the 2031 depths; the full-life rate is the field's own rate for one inspection. G7 first (honest, kept against the guard's suggestion to redraw it): the pit corrodes only inside its zone's window of failed protection; G13: the growth window is not the asset's age. The older same-puzzle and same-driver signatures (time, G7) are answered by one differentiation line each, all six builds' drivers read and none of them dates a growing period from a protection record. Calibration physical_verification: the 2025 dig verifications (laser-scanned field depths) confirm the tool's sizing, which a solver checks before trusting the depths. Forum regulator_or_inspector (the plan is filed with the state pipeline safety office), forcing event statutory_or_regulatory_filing (the plan's filing date), org family utility_or_infrastructure: none among the last three registrations (task146, task232, task190).
